the_three_caveats_fixed.caveat_1_convergence: Mordvintsev POOL + sample-replay + fire-rate + random CA steps + multi-restart keep-best
the_three_caveats_fixed.caveat_2_amortization: ONE shared rule across 4 REAL frames + per-frame latents; AVERAGE d_seg + TRUE amortized rate
the_three_caveats_fixed.caveat_3_capacity_break: rule-size sweep -> avg d_seg(params) vs 29.3*params^-0.71 power law

method.representation: ONE shared NCA rule (perception fixed Sobel+ident, MLP w1/b1/w2 zero-init residual, readout C->3 RGB) + per-frame latent seeds. grow_rgb iterates SAME rule per frame.
method.stabilizers: persistent state pool + sample-replay (replace highest-loss with fresh seed) + fire-rate 0.5 + random CA steps [48,72] + per-param grad-norm + LR warmup + step-decay + 1 restarts keep-best
method.dseg_metric: AVERAGE over frames of realized argmax-flip-rate through the EXACT roundtrip vs L* (CPU authority)

capacity_break.interpretation: If our_fitted_exponent_k > 0.71 AND points land below the power law, weight-shared iteration gives effective-depth-N detail that the one-shot decoder lacks (the capacity escape). If k ~ 0.71 or points sit on/above the wall, iteration does NOT break the capacity wall = the generative axis caps like the static families.

verdict_basis: MEASUREMENT-FIRST: AVERAGE realized d_seg (NOT best-frame) of ONE shared rule across 4 real frames, through the real SegNet + exact roundtrip, multi-restart keep-best for convergence robustness. The capacity-break is the fitted d_seg(params) exponent vs 29.3*params^-0.71.
